Foundation Panel 的功能更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A feature update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 反馈面板新增截图一栏：一键截取面板窗口，也可选图或粘贴，发送前可预览、遮盖和移除。
  The feedback panel gains a screenshot field: capture the panel window in one click, or pick or paste an image, then preview, cover and remove parts before sending.
- 概览新增帧率来源、麦克风、捕获方式和链路余量磁贴。
  The overview adds tiles for the frame-rate source, microphone, capture method and link headroom.
- 支持识别 Foundation Sunshine 附带的精简版 USB/IP；用户自己安装的 USB/IP（包括带图形界面或开发包的完整版）保持原样，兼容的 0.9.8.1 可直接使用，不会被卸载或替换。
  Supports the slim USB/IP shipped with Foundation Sunshine; a USB/IP installed by the user (including the full edition with its GUI or SDK) is left as it is, a compatible 0.9.8.1 is used directly, and it is never uninstalled or replaced.
- 面板主程序由约 47.8 MB 缩小到约 29 MB，崩溃报告所需的符号文件单独归档。
  The panel executable shrinks from about 47.8 MB to about 29 MB; the symbols needed to decode crash reports are archived separately.
- 修复侧栏和概览的音频输出显示设备编号的问题，现按设备名称显示。
  Fixes the audio output in the sidebar and the overview showing a device ID; it now shows the device name.
- 修复检查更新时提示重复、需要排队等待的问题，现在只保留一条提示。
  Fixes duplicated, queued messages while checking for updates; one message now carries the check from start to finish.
- 修复按钮按下和松开时圆角变成直角、跳回的问题。
  Fixes button corners turning square and snapping back when pressed and released.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
